_comment: Copy this file to config.json and fill in your values. Never commit config.json.
_comment_teams_chat_id: Optional. If left null the script scans your chat list automatically. To hard-code: open the DM in Teams, copy the chat URL, the long ID after /conversations/ is the chat_id.
teams_chat_id: ONLY USE TEAMS CHAT ID FOR NOW
_comment_ssl_verify: False = skip SSL verification. Set true only if you have manually added required certs to Python's certification bundle.
